// REQ: LANG-1791 LANG-1792 LANG-1793 LANG-1794
module demo {
  yang-version 1.1;
  namespace "urn:example:demo";
  prefix d;
  /* A container */
  container system {
    leaf hostname {
      type string { length "1..253"; }
      mandatory true;
    }
    list user {
      key "name";
      leaf name { type string; }
      leaf uid { type uint32 { range "1000..65535"; } }
    }
  }
}
